built: The middle layer: db (GORM on cgo-free SQLite, split writer/reader pools, translated constraint errors), sessions (revocable rows, step-up RequireFresh), csrf, flash, form, view, scope — each importable alone, tested alone
rastrillo/auth — the family default sign-in: magic-link email that auto-upgrades to Keymail when the address has a claimed inbox, over keymaildev/signin
rastrillo/password — classic email+password on the sessions core: stdlib PBKDF2, per-account rate limiting, one non-oracle failure message
SKILL.md — the authoring contract, under 15,000 bytes, reviewed like code: what an agent loads instead of the framework source
examples/notes — accounts, sessions, CSRF, flash, and owner-scoped CRUD in 163 domain lines, with a two-user isolation suite in CI
rastrillo/crypto — the family envelope: P-256 sealing and signing, invite derivation and key wrapping, a WebCrypto JS twin — all pinned by golden vectors from real consumers
rastrillo/webauthn — passkeys, verify-only, with a test authenticator and the browser module included
rastrillo/eventlog — the mergeable store shape: append-only streams, pure Derive, deterministic merge pinned by vectors
rastrillo/blobs — content-addressed bytes on the platform's object store, presigned URLs, sealed E2EE wrapper
rastrillo.Resolve/Serve/Run — the full platform activation contract, hibernate and systemd tenants included
SQLite bootstrap: pragma ordering, single-writer, additive migrations
Localization: locale-resolved routes, T/Tf with fallback, a ship-gate catalog check
rastrillo/ui — the component vocabulary: 27 partials, documented class idioms, design tokens — light and dark, WCAG AA enforced by tests, zero JavaScript

The manifest path: a declared Resource generates store, actions, screens, and locale keys — an optional, equal alternative to hand-written handlers, mixed per resource; examples/tickets is its regression suite
Agents: actions opt in as tools; the generated registry dispatches consent-gated, actor-attributed calls; sidecars speak the platform contract
notyet: A middle-layer scaffold — rastrillo new still writes the manifest-era shape; start from examples/notes and SKILL.md instead
Passkey second factor on the step-up seam (rastrillo/webauthn is built; the wired 2FA flow is not)
Manifest resources with per-user scoping, and a thinner emitter that composes the middle-layer primitives harder — the declarative path should reach where the code path does
